title: session.created payload v1
description: The learner picked a topic; the session pins a copy of that topic's subtree, fixed at creation, together with the identity of the pack it was chosen from (ADR-0018, issue #34/#54).

topic_id.description: Id of the chosen topic within the pack's topic tree.

tree.description: Copy of the chosen topic's subtree, as it was at creation time. Never updated when the pack changes.
